Title: Azure Cosmos DB: Glowroot support for Cassandra API in general availability

Body.Content:
Glowroot is an open source application performance management tool used to optimize and monitor the performance of your Java-based applications. Now you can access Glowroot within the Azure Cosmos DB Cassandra API to monitor application performance without having to update your application. Glowroot support is easy to configure and is optimized for low resource utilization. To help support Glowroot, three new features have been added to the Azure Cosmos DB Cassandra API; truncate, light weight transaction, and named indexes. Glowroot allows you to get the average time taken for database queries and traces your slowest 500 requests.

Learn more.
